validation_notes: Processed 10 MAGN people from CSV: 1 CEO and 9 other board/TMT entries. Checked 2 local documents in MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/MAGN: Годовой отчет 2024 ММК.pdf and IFRS_RUR_2412.pdf. Total research rounds: 10 person-rounds, one per person. Education was found for all 10 people. Weak or secondary sources used: Softline for Rashid Ismailov's education because MMK 2021 only states higher professional education; DisserCat for Shilyaev and Ushakov dissertation details; AKM-hosted copy of MMK 2019 annual report where the official 2024 MMK disclosures no longer provide biographies. Key conflict/limitation: the 2024 local annual report confirms a 10-person board and no change versus the board elected on 26 May 2023, but does not disclose names; the 2024 voting report also withholds candidate/resolution details under Government Decree No. 1102. The named 2024 people are therefore anchored by CSV, 2024 local board context, 2024 chairman/CEO local facts, the official MMK 2021 named board list, and detailed MMK 2019/2021 biographies. Rejected namesakes: Rashid Ismailov public-policy/ecology profile with inconsistent education; generic Olga Naumova academic profiles; generic Sergey Ushakov/Ralph Morgan/Andrey Eremin search results without MMK or employer-chain markers. Publications, patents and h-index are empty unless a specific verified scientific profile was found; generic claims of publications or inventions were not expanded. Search considered complete because local documents, official/issuer reports, prior employer sources, education-specific searches, career-chain searches, dissertation searches and namesake checks were completed with no remaining unverified employer or university lead material enough to change the JSON. ROUND 2 (2026-07-19, gap-fill + GICS/qualification_degree/university-normalization pass, per REFINEMENT.md and this round's task brief): Local filings re-checked first -- confirmed via a full-text scan of both MOEXBMI_Otchety_2024/MAGN files that only Shilyaev (CEO) and Rashnikov/Rashnikova appear by name in the 2024 annual report (intro/signature pages), and neither local document discloses other board members' biographies, matching round 1's conclusion; no new local-filing facts were available this round. Went to web/primary-source research next: downloaded and read the two external primary sources already cited in round 1 (MMK 2019 annual report via akm.ru and MMK Q2 2021 quarterly report via mmk.ru) directly page-by-page instead of relying on round-1 summaries, which surfaced one significant correction and several precise gap-fills. CORRECTION: Shilyaev's research_experience dissertation entry and one ceo.sources entry pointed to the wrong DisserCat record in round 1 (a namesake mix-up -- that record is actually Chertousov A.A.'s 2004 dissertation); the real Shilyaev dissertation was located via a dissercat.com site search and confirmed by its own page metadata (title/citation_author/citation_publication_date), giving degrees[0].field and a corrected research_experience entry, both consistent with degrees[0].year=2010 already on file. CORRECTION: Ushakov's dissertation year was 2017 in round 1; a direct fetch of the same DisserCat URL's own title/meta tags shows 2020 -- round 1 misread the year from that page; corrected degrees[0].year and research_experience accordingly, and field filled with the VAK specialty (05.16.02). GAP-FILL: Rashnikov's degrees[0].year (Doctor of Technical Sciences) filled as 1996 by cross-referencing the already-sourced uralfo.gov.ru research_experience entry on file since round 1. GAP-FILL: Rashnikov's vague combined professional_experience entry (World Steel Association/KHL/Russkaya Stal/RSPP/regional associations) was split into five dated entries using precise start years found on p.95 of the MMK 2019 annual report (read directly this round); all five are trade/industry associations or a non-profit sports league, not GICS-classifiable companies, so their sector/industry_group/industry are null with that reasoning, not guessed. GAP-FILL: identified full legal names for three previously vague organizations by direct read of the MMK Q2 2021 report -- TSTR Nekst = OOO Tsentr tekhnologiy robotizatsii Nekst (Eremin), and Data Center Processing and Automation = AO Dannye - tsentr obrabotki i avtomatizatsii (Ismailov) -- and used Russian corporate-registry lookups (list-org.com, by company name/INN) to confirm primary OKVED codes for several ambiguous MMK-adjacent entities: OOO TSTR Nekst (OKVED 62.02, IT consultancy), OOO MAGSTORN (OKVED 68.20.2, non-residential real-estate management, Rashnikova), OOO TD Cherkizovo (OKVED 46.32.1, wholesale meat/poultry trade, Naumova) and OOO Vostochnye roznichnye seti (OKVED 46.31, wholesale fruit/vegetable trade, Naumova). Split three more combined multi-organization professional_experience entries into individual entries for per-organization GICS classification: Naumova's 'Russian Fishery Company, Sollers Auto and Russian Crab' (into 3) and Rashnikova's 'OOO MEK and OOO Energopark' (into 2, both left with null GICS tags because the names are too generic to match to one specific registry entry with confidence). GICS SECTOR/INDUSTRY: added company-level sector=Materials/industry_group=Materials/industry=Metals & Mining (MMK is a steel producer; all GICS strings copied character-for-character from gics_taxonomy.json) and a sector/industry_group/industry triple to every professional_experience entry for all 10 people; government bodies (Ministry of Telecom, Government of Saint Petersburg), industry/trade associations, a sports league, and a handful of unidentifiable shell-like entities (Bashkiria Trading House, Lorus SCM, OOO MEK, OOO Energopark) were left null/null/null with a reason recorded in that entry's description rather than forced into a GICS bucket. QUALIFICATION_DEGREE: added to every education[]/degrees[] entry for all 10 people. Soviet/Russian pre-Bologna (pre-~2003) higher-education completions with an explicit specialist-style qualification title (inzhener-metallurg, menedzher, ekonomika i upravlenie v metallurgicheskoy promyshlennosti, inzhenernaya elektrofizika, Marketing/MGU 1994) were classified 'Specialist degree', consistent with the heuristic already established for other tickers in this project (see e.g. DVEC/ALRS validation_notes); explicit MBA/Executive MBA labels -> 'MBA'; explicit Bachelor of Arts/Master's-degree labels (Morgan, Rashnikova's Franklin College) -> 'Bachelor's degree'/'Master's degree'; short non-degree-conferring executive programs (Shilyaev's Stockholm SSE program, Martsinovich's London Guildhall postgraduate specialization) -> 'Executive education'; kandidat/doktor nauk degrees -> 'Doctoral degree' (Russia's two-tier system has no separate bucket in the ten allowed values); 'Professor' academic-rank entries -> null (not a degree, per the same convention used for this title elsewhere in the project). Left null wherever no source gave enough detail to infer a degree level with high confidence -- notably Ismailov's 2007 Moscow Polytechnic/MAMI entry and Ushakov's 2017 Metallurgy entry, the latter because 2017 falls after Russia's Bologna transition and no source states whether it was a Bachelor's, Master's, or a retained Specialist-track program. UNIVERSITY NORMALIZATION: all 16 distinct raw institution strings used across the 10 people already had a canonical entry in university_names.json (Chelyabinsk State Technical University -> Yuzhno-Uralskiy gosudarstvennyy universitet; Magnitogorsk Mining-Metallurgical Institute -> Magnitogorsk State Technical University named after G.I. Nosov; Gdansk University -> Uniwersytet Gdanski; London Guildhall University -> London Metropolitan University; and others listed in the round-2 research notes), so new_institutions_found is empty for this ticker -- nothing to add. Nothing confirmed in round 1 was deleted; every change above either adds a previously-null/vague field or corrects a demonstrable citation/date error found by re-reading the same primary sources already on file, with the correction documented in place rather than silently overwritten. DATA-LOSS REPAIR (2026-07-30): restored 8 shortened person notes, 2 shortened experience descriptions, 0 shortened education descriptions, 0 missing person-level sources, and 0 missing experience-level sources using git HEAD (commit 03bfe9f, 2026-07-20) as the reliable baseline. Nothing else in this file was touched. Additional repair: restored the full confirmed legal name for 1 professional_experience entry/entries (АНО "ЦКМСЧ" -> full name with abbreviation), verified by round 2 against MMK 2019 annual report p.96 and MMK Q2 2021 report p.77; this had been silently shortened back to the bare abbreviation.
